steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to Odoo at http://127.0.0.1:8069/ using login admin and password exactly {{env:APP_PASSWORD}}, and verify that the authenticated Odoo app is open.
02-create: Create a customer named {{runid}} Bench Customer with City set to Benchville. Ensure the customer name is selected/accepted in Odoo, save it, then verify the saved customer and city.

03-create: Create a new quotation for customer {{runid}} Bench Customer with exactly one order line: choose any real product from the catalogue via its autocomplete option and set quantity 3. Save the quotation and verify the customer, product, unit price, quantity, and untaxed amount shown by Odoo.

04-add: On quotation {{03-create.order_reference}}, add a second order line using a different catalogue product selected from autocomplete, with quantity 2. Save and verify both line products/quantities and the resulting untaxed amount.
05-change: On quotation {{03-create.order_reference}}, change the first line ({{03-create.product}}) quantity from 3 to 5, save, and verify the first line quantity and updated untaxed amount.
06-verify: Confirm quotation {{03-create.order_reference}} to convert it to a sales order, and verify its order reference and the status shown after confirmation.

07-verify: Cancel sales order {{03-create.order_reference}} so it is no longer active, handling any confirmation dialog if needed. Verify after the action (and reload if appropriate) the status displayed for {{03-create.order_reference}}.
